unique.reason: No error handling leaves a false 'Price checked just now' and can render '£undefined'; out-of-stock leaves Add to basket active. Real, can mislead on purchase.
Breadcrumb uses literal '›' separators, no list structure and no current-page item. Real but small navigational noise.
role=region on a single-image 'gallery' and price fragment adds low-value landmarks and implies a gallery that does not exist. Minor clutter.
Fixed 18rem image width without max-width overflows narrow viewports when users raise default font size, causing horizontal scrolling. Real, minor.
60rem container gives roughly 110+ characters per line for body text, including Safety; a real readability burden for some readers.
'1.7L' is read intelligibly by screen readers and the Description clarifies litres; too trivial to report.
Meta-commentary on the 'AI agent ready' framing and provenance; identifies no concrete barrier in the material beyond those already listed.
Speculative privacy inference from polling; admits no demonstrated leak or disability-revealing data. Not a real exposure shown by this material.
